whoosh.use: Showy slide transitions (push, slide, zoom, whip, morph) and big camera moves; the default transition whoosh, pans left to right.

whoosh-soft.use: Gentle transitions and secondary camera drifts; darker, shorter and quieter than whoosh.

swipe.use: Fast directional moves: swipe/wipe transitions, cards sliding in, carousel steps, quick zooms.

pop.use: Playful element pops: popIn/bounce entrances, badges, emoji, bubbles, counters landing.

pop-soft.use: Default for emphasis entrances (spring, scaleIn, overshoot, letterSpring); subtle enough to repeat.

tick.use: Word hits (WORD_HITS), bullet reveals, counter steps, timeline markers.

click.use: UI interactions: cursor clicks, button presses, toggles, tab switches in product demos.

sparkle.use: Magic/highlight moments: glow, shine, starPop, sparkle effects, revealing a key insight.

riser.use: Build-up into a big reveal or the final CTA; place it so it ends on the reveal (pairs with impact).

impact.use: Hero moments: title slams, big stat reveals, logo hits, the drop after a riser. Use sparingly.

chime.use: Notifications, 'aha' moments, checkmarks appearing, gentle positive confirmations.

typing.use: On-screen typing: typewriter, code, terminal and search-box animations (loop or trim to length).

confetti.use: Celebrations: confettiBurst, partyPopper, confettiRain, fireworks, milestones.

success.use: Completion / win: checkDraw, badgeUnlock, trophyShine, goal reached, 'done' states.
